24183: The protagonist. Historically he died in 1600. When he first arrived in the world, he was critically injured, only to be brought to the hideout of Nobunaga and Yoichi by some young "elves".
24184: A famous warlord who conquered most of Japan during Sengoku period. Historically he is known for being the daimyo who took the first step of unification of the Japan, and the first Japanese military commander to utilize arquebuses in battles.
24200: A very effeminate man of nineteen. Although he died many years before Nobunaga and Toyohisa, Yoichi is the youngest in the group. His historical death date is unclear, yet some records indicate that he either died on August 8 in 1189 or in October of 1190.
29970: Hannibal's Roman adversary during the Second Punic War, who is believed to have died around 183 BC. As a Drifter, he is as old as Hannibal, who he is seen constantly arguing with, claiming that "a winner takes all" since he won at Zama.
29971: The hero of the Hundred Years War between France and England. Joan, who was driven insane after being burned at the stake, now desires nothing more than to see the world burn.
32930: A famous Russian mystic who once held a great influence over the Russian Imperial Court because of his ability to supposedly heal the Romanov's hemophiliac heir, Alexei. He now serves the Black King.
34584: The former vice-commander of the Shinsengumi who died fighting in the name of the Tokugawa Bakufu during the Boshin War. Hijikata has the ability to use smoke in order to manifest ghostly images of members of the Shinsengumi and uses them to cut apart his enemies.
34734: The youngest daughter of the last Russian tsar, Nicholas II. Anastasia and her family were shot by a Bolshevik firing squad when Anastasia was seventeen. Now she has the supernatural ability to create blizzards.
37822: Hannibal, son of Hamilcar Barca (248–183 or 182 BC), was a Carthaginian military commander and tactician who is popularly credited as one of the most talented commanders in history.
43709: During a battle with the Black King, with the Drifters' side under attack by dragons, World War II fighter pilot Naoshi Kanno is transported into the world in his plane. He decides to attack the dragons when their attacks remind him of the US bombing of Tokyo.
43710: The Black King is the apparent leader of the Offscourings. He claims that he once tried to "save" humans but he has since shifted his agenda towards nonhumans after humans "denied" his efforts. His identity has yet to be established but he is shown to possess healing powers.
43711: A French nobleman who was once one of Joan's companions-in-arms but was later executed for multiple cases of murder, sodomy, and heresy. He apparently continues to accompany Joan to battle even in death.
43712: While he fights for the Offscourings, Minamoto is allowed by the Black King to fight when he wants to and against whom. Although he was Yoichi's leader in the past, it is unknown what their dynamic will be like in this world.
43713: The infamous Führer and Chancellor of Nazi Germany.
43714: A nobleman who owns a quarter of the Empire and was Hitler's closest ally in its formation. It is said that the Empire could not have existed without his "betrayal," and as such he is free to live as he pleases without criticism from any of his peers.
43715: A young magician of the Octobrists. She was charged with watching Toyohisa's group of Drifters. She seems to be quite incompetent at reconnaissance, and is terrified of the Drifters she must follow.
43716: A young man who is one of the head of the Octobrist who has allied himself with the Drifters against the Black King.
43718: A Caucasian, bespectacled man who constantly wears a suit. He is apparently the one responsible for the appearance of the Drifters, using them as a means to right the wrong of the Offscourings' conquest of the magical world.
43719: A young woman with long-black hair. Apparently at odds with Murasaki, she is responsible for the Offscourings, an opposing force similar in origin to the Drifters. In the corridor she is associated with and accompanied by darkness.
74647: Robert LeRoy Parker, better known as Butch Cassidy, is a well known American Wild West outlaw specialized in train and bank robbery. A leader of the Wild Bunch Gang, Sudance Kid's partner and now a Drifter fighting against the Black King.
74649: Harry Alonzo Longabaugh, better known as Sundance Kid, is a well known American Wild West outlaw specialized in train and bank robbery. A notorious member of the Wild Bunch Gang, Butch Cassidy's partner and now a Drifter fighting against the Black King.
81233: A comrade and subordinate to Count Saint-Germi alongside with Flemi, Alester seems to share his master's non-traditional sexual orientation (additionally Alester only likes elder men), eccentric behaviour and a habit to wear an outrageous makeup.
81235: A comrade and subordinate to Count Saint-Germi alongside with Alester, Flemi seems to share his master's non-traditional sexual orientation (additionally Flemi only likes teenage boys), eccentric behaviour and a habit to wear an outrageous makeup.
292581: Toyohisa's uncle and the leader of the Shimazu clan.
